items.title: Polar Client 1.0.2
items.body: The Cosmetics Update! 80 original capes, wings, hats, back items and auras, most of them animated. Pick yours in the launcher under Cosmetics → Polar wardrobe, and other Polar players see them in game. Polar players now get a snowflake badge next to their name. New Friends page: see who's online and which server they're on, join them in one click or invite them (press Y in game to accept an invite). Your Polar settings, HUD layout and waypoints now sync between your PCs.

items.title: Polar Client 1.0.1
items.body: First public release: five Minecraft versions, 79 mods

items.title: Polar Client 1.0.0
items.body: First Launch of the Polar Client.

items.title: Resource packs, shaders, a minimap and more
items.body: Browse now has Resource packs and Shaders tabs: install one and it's switched on for your next game. New in game: a minimap with your waypoints, coloured hitboxes you toggle with H, and Hide Far Entities for more FPS in busy lobbies. The launcher has a skin library and shows what you're playing on Discord.

items.title: 19 new mods
items.body: Chat timestamps, chat filter, click-to-copy and compact chat. Low Fire, Clear Water, Time & Weather, particle control, hit and glint colours. Inventory search, shulker previews and exact durability. A movable scoreboard, boss bar and tab list, waypoints with light beams, and a key to copy your coordinates.

items.title: Crash helper, screenshots and mod profiles
items.body: When the game crashes, the launcher now tells you why in plain words. Browse your screenshots from every version, save sets of mods as profiles, update mods with one click, and let the launcher update itself.
